properties.displayName: OSS Trust — Runtime Anomaly in Monitored Package
properties.description: Detects process or network behavior consistent with supply-chain compromise from a package approved by the OSS Trust Framework within the 30-day post-deployment monitoring window.
properties.query:
let monitoring_packages = externaldata(package_name:string, quorum_id:string, trust_level:string, monitoring_expires_at:datetime, trust_score:int)
  ['https://storage.your-org.com/oss-trust/monitoring-packages.csv']
  with(format='csv');
let sensitive_paths = dynamic(['/etc/passwd', '/etc/shadow', '/.ssh/', '/.aws/', '/.gcloud/', '/proc/self/environ']);
let suspicious_procs = dynamic(['curl', 'wget', 'nc', 'ncat', 'python', 'perl', 'ruby']);
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(5m)
| extend proc_name = tostring(split(CommandLine, ' ')[0])
| where proc_name in (suspicious_procs)
   or CommandLine has_any (sensitive_paths)
| join kind=inner (monitoring_packages | where monitoring_expires_at > now()) on $left.Computer == $right.package_name
| extend anomaly_type = case(
    CommandLine has_any(sensitive_paths), 'sensitive_file_access',
    proc_name in (suspicious_procs), 'suspicious_process_execution',
    'unknown'
  )
| extend days_in_window = datetime_diff('day', now(), monitoring_expires_at - 30d)
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, CommandLine, proc_name, anomaly_type,
          package_name, quorum_id, trust_level, trust_score, days_in_window
